description: Live or planned status of a flight via the official FlightAware AeroAPI: times (scheduled/estimated/actual), delays, gates/terminals, aircraft, progress, cancelled/diverted flags, plus flightaware.com tracking links. Operational data, not prices. Requires the FLIGHTAWARE_API_KEY secret; each call bills AeroAPI usage.

ident.description: Flight ident: IATA number (LO281), ICAO number (BAW123), or tail/registration (SP-LVD).

max_pages.description: AeroAPI pagination cap — how many result pages to fetch (each page bills separately). Default 1.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh AeroAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

name: flightaware_flight_status
title: FlightAware flight status (AeroAPI)
